risk_summary: The excerpt presents a generally confident growth narrative supported by geographic sales and distributor metrics, but relies heavily on management-defined operating measures and promotional descriptions. Key risk disclosures include limited cash repatriation in Venezuela, foreign-exchange impacts, distributor retention and unemployment sensitivity, and limited visibility into end-customer sales. Long, highly detailed explanations and qualification caveats modestly reduce transparency.
